nodes.description: mapping(bytes32=>uint256) in EternalStorage holding all numeric bridge state (limits, spent/executed amounts, gas limit, mediator balance).
mapping(bytes32=>address) in EternalStorage holding owner, bridge contract, mediator, token image and token pair addresses.
mapping(bytes32=>bool) in EternalStorage holding flags such as the reentrancy LOCK and INITIALIZED.
mapping(bytes32=>int256) in EternalStorage holding forwarding rule lanes for MultiTokenForwardingRules.
Constant key keccak256('owner') used to index the owner address in addressStorage.
Constant key for the AMB bridge contract address stored in addressStorage.
Constant key for the mediator contract address on the other network.
Constant key for the gas limit used when sending messages through the AMB bridge.
Constant key for the reentrancy lock flag stored in boolStorage.
Constant key for the initialization flag stored in boolStorage.
Constant key for the token image (implementation) address used to deploy TokenProxy instances.
Constant fee type key for the home-to-foreign bridge direction.
Constant fee type key for the foreign-to-home bridge direction.
Constant key for the number of registered reward addresses in the linked list.
Tracked token balance of the foreign mediator, stored in uintStorage under keccak256('mediatorBalance', token).
External entry point initiating a bridge operation for a given ERC677 token amount and receiver.
Internal relay implementation: validates limits, moves tokens via transferFrom/safeTransferFrom and triggers the bridge actions.
ERC677 transfer callback executed by the token contract during transferAndCall, guarded by the LOCK flag.
onlyMediator function handling tokens bridged in from the other network.
onlyMediator function that deploys a TokenProxy for a new foreign token and mints the bridged amount.
Checks the execution limits and either executes the bridged action or reverts via the out-of-limit handler.
Executes the token action on bridged tokens (mint on home, safeTransfer on foreign) after fee distribution.
Rolls back a failed message by minting or transferring tokens back to the recipient.
Bridge-direction specific logic executed on token transfer: fee distribution, burn/lock and message passing.
Builds and sends the AMB message to the other network and stores message metadata for failure handling.
onlyMediator handler that fixes a failed message by returning tokens to the original sender, explicitly burnable into a nonce.
Public function requesting the other side to fix/roll back assets of a failed message execution.
Initializer guarded by onlyRelevantSender that wires bridge/mediator addresses, limits, fees, owner and token image.
onlyOwner setter validating and writing the outgoing daily limit for a token.
onlyOwner setter validating and writing the maximum amount per outgoing transfer.
onlyOwner setter validating and writing the minimum amount per outgoing transfer.
View function computing whether an amount fits within daily limit, maxPerTx and minPerTx.
Internal accounting function adding the bridged value to the per-day spent counter using SafeMath.add.
onlyIfUpgradeabilityOwner function claiming unregistered tokens or native coins from the mediator.
onlyOwner function transferring contract ownership to a new address.
Internal ownership setter validating the new owner and writing to addressStorage.
Computes and splits the fee proportionally between reward addresses, transferring or minting tokens to each.
Internal fee setter validating the fee type, the fee bound and token registration.
onlyOwner function adding a new fee reward address to the linked list.
onlyIfUpgradeabilityOwner function bridging the difference between actual and tracked token balance.
Derives per-token limits from the default limits scaled by the token decimals and applies SafeMath mul/div.
Fallback function of Proxy performing a raw delegatecall to the implementation address using assembly.
Helper choosing the actual receiver from sender and transfer data, decoding raw bytes into an address.
SafeERC20 helper performing an external token transfer and validating the returned data via assembly.
SafeERC20 helper performing an external token transferFrom and validating the returned data via assembly.
View function returning the owner address read from addressStorage[OWNER].
View function returning now / 1 days, introducing block.timestamp dependency into limit accounting.
Internal function computing a pseudo-random index from blockhash(block.number - 1) modulo count.
Internal function dispatching claim of native coins or ERC20 tokens with a valid-address modifier.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, token custody and receiver defaults.
now, used by getCurrentDay for the daily limit accounting window (timestamp dependency).
External call to token.transferFrom / safeTransferFrom that hands control to a user-supplied token contract.
ERC677 callback re-entering onTokenTransfer during a token transfer, mitigated only by the LOCK flag in some paths.
External transfer/mint call to an arbitrary token address inside _distributeFee executed after state updates.
Raw assembly delegatecall in the Proxy fallback forwarding arbitrary calldata to the implementation.
selfdestruct used by the Sacrifice contract to force native value transfers when send fails.
Low-level address(this).call used in onlyRelevantSender to probe the upgradeability owner selector.
Native value transfer via _receiver.send inside Address.safeSendValue with a selfdestruct fallback.
Use of blockhash(block.number - 1) as a source of randomness for fee remainder allocation.
Inline assembly extcodesize check used by AddressUtils.isContract to validate contract addresses.
ERC677 token argument of relayTokens.
Receiver address argument of relayTokens.
Bridged amount argument of relayTokens.
Sender address argument provided by the ERC677 token during onTokenTransfer.
Optional payload argument of onTokenTransfer used for the alternative receiver.
Message id argument of fixFailedMessage selecting the message to roll back.
Fee type argument (HOME_TO_FOREIGN_FEE or FOREIGN_TO_HOME_FEE) of setFee/_setFee.
Fee value argument of setFee/_setFee, a percentage scaled by MAX_FEE.
Array of limit values passed to the internal _setLimits helper.
New daily limit argument of setDailyLimit.
Local ERC677 token variable built from msg.sender inside onTokenTransfer.
Local amount remaining after the fee is subtracted before burning tokens.
Local fee amount computed by _distributeFee and subtracted from the bridged value.
Local value of total spent/executed per day plus the new amount used in withinLimit calculations.
Local address of the newly deployed TokenProxy home token in deployAndHandleBridgedTokens.
Local foreign token address resolved in passMessage for the AMB message payload.
Local message id returned by the bridge call and written to the message metadata storage.

edges.reason: relayTokens delegates all logic to the internal _relayTokens implementation.
_relayTokens ends by invoking bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer to burn and pass the message.
onTokenTransfer validates the amount through withinLimit before accounting.
onTokenTransfer calls bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer when the lock is free.
onTokenTransfer adds the spent amount for the current day after the limit check.
bridgeSpecificActionsOnTokenTransfer invokes passMessage to notify the other network.
handleBridgedTokens delegates to _handleBridgedTokens.
deployAndHandleBridgedTokens ends by calling _handleBridgedTokens for the minted amount.
_handleBridgedTokens branches on withinExecutionLimit which shares the daily limit helpers.
_handleBridgedTokens calls executeActionOnBridgedTokens when inside the execution limits.
executeActionOnBridgedTokens distributes the foreign-to-home fee before minting.
fixFailedMessage calls executeActionOnFixedTokens to return the tokens to the sender.
requestFailedMessageFix builds a message that ultimately flows through the AMB passMessage path.
_relayTokens requires withinLimit before moving tokens.
_relayTokens records the spent amount per day before calling the token.
fixMediatorBalance accounts the forced-in difference as spent per day.
msg.sender is used as the token sender address in _relayTokens without further authorization.
msg.sender is cast into the ERC677 token address inside onTokenTransfer.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner(), the core authorization check.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier reading msg.sender.
claimTokens is restricted by onlyIfUpgradeabilityOwner using msg.sender.
fixMediatorBalance is restricted by onlyIfUpgradeabilityOwner using msg.sender.
initialize is guarded by onlyRelevantSender which evaluates msg.sender.
addRewardAddress is onlyOwner and thus depends on msg.sender.
setDailyLimit is onlyOwner and depends on msg.sender.
setMaxPerTx is onlyOwner and depends on msg.sender.
setMinPerTx is onlyOwner and depends on msg.sender.
_setFee is reached from the onlyOwner setFee external entry point.
handleBridgedTokens is onlyMediator and validates msg.sender against the bridge contract.
deployAndHandleBridgedTokens is onlyMediator and validates msg.sender against the bridge contract.
Any caller triggers the Proxy fallback which forwards the calldata.
getCurrentDay divides now by one day, making limit accounting timestamp dependent.
addTotalSpentPerDay keys its accounting by the timestamp-derived current day.
The token parameter of relayTokens is forwarded into the relay logic.
The receiver parameter of relayTokens is forwarded to the bridge action.
The value parameter of relayTokens is forwarded to the relay logic.
The bridged value is compared against maxPerTx and minPerTx inside withinLimit.
The from parameter supplied by the token callback is used as the sender.
The data parameter of onTokenTransfer is forwarded to chooseReceiver.
The messageId parameter selects the stored message metadata to roll back.
The fee type parameter is validated and used as the storage key in _setFee.
The fee value parameter is validated against MAX_FEE and stored.
The limits array is consumed by _initializeTokenBridgeLimits when deriving per-token limits.
The new daily limit parameter is validated against maxPerTx and written.
The local token built from msg.sender is used for all limit and accounting calls.
The local token is the key used when querying limits in withinLimit.
valueToBridge is the amount passed to burn and passMessage after fee subtraction.
The local fee variable is the amount returned by _distributeFee and deducted from the bridged value.
nextLimit is the daily limit comparison value computed in withinLimit.
The newly deployed home token address is used for limit, fee and mint operations.
The foreign token address is embedded into the AMB message payload.
The message id returned by the bridge call is stored and later consumed by fixFailedMessage.
_relayTokens performs an external token.transferFrom/safeTransferFrom that can re-enter the contract through the ERC677 callback.
safeTransferFrom executes the external transferFrom call guarded only by inline return-data checks.
_relayTokens sets the reentrancy lock around the external transfer.
onTokenTransfer reads the lock flag to avoid double message passing.
The ERC677 token callbacks into onTokenTransfer while the mediator is mid-transfer, the classic reentrancy surface.
executeActionOnBridgedTokens mints on a token contract that may execute arbitrary code.
_distributeFee calls transfer/mint on a token address derived from the message before all accounting completes.
_distributeFee calls random to pick the account receiving the remainder.
random uses blockhash of the previous block as entropy, which is miner-influenced.
The Proxy fallback performs an assembly delegatecall to the implementation with raw calldata.
claimValues forwards native coins through Address.safeSendValue which uses a low-level send.
When send fails, safeSendValue deploys Sacrifice whose constructor selfdestructs to the receiver.
initialize is protected by onlyRelevantSender which performs a low-level call on the contract itself.
passMessage reads the bridge contract address from addressStorage.
passMessage resolves the mediator contract on the other side as the executor.
passMessage reads the configured request gas limit before sending the AMB message.
deployAndHandleBridgedTokens reads the token image to deploy the TokenProxy.
executeActionOnBridgedTokens uses the FOREIGN_TO_HOME_FEE key when distributing fees.
addRewardAddress increments the stored reward address count key.
fixMediatorBalance reads and updates the tracked mediator balance.
addTotalSpentPerDay writes the accumulated per-day amount into uintStorage.
withinLimit reads dailyLimit, maxPerTx, minPerTx and spent amounts from uintStorage.
_setFee writes the fee value into uintStorage under the fee type and token key.
_setOwner writes the new owner address into addressStorage.
owner() reads the owner address from addressStorage[OWNER].
initialize writes the initial owner using the OWNER key.
initialize sets the INITIALIZED flag via setInitialize.

normalization_plan.reason: The token argument is a transient ERC677 handle fully consumed by the relayTokens entry point and can be merged into it.
The receiver argument only routes the bridge payload and carries no independent state, so it merges into relayTokens.
The value argument is a plain amount validated and forwarded by relayTokens, so it merges into that function.
The from argument is supplied by the calling token and only used inside onTokenTransfer.
The data payload is decoded inside the callback path and can be merged into onTokenTransfer.
The message id parameter is only a storage lookup key within fixFailedMessage.
The fee type parameter is validated and used as a storage key by the internal fee setter.
The fee value parameter is bounded and persisted by the internal fee setter.
The limits array is consumed solely while deriving per-token limits in the initialization routine.
The daily limit parameter is validated and stored by setDailyLimit only.
The local token alias derived from msg.sender has no meaning outside the callback and merges into it.
The post-fee amount exists only to burn and pass the message inside the bridge action.
The fee local is the direct return value of the fee distribution routine and merges into it.
The projected limit value is a temporary comparison variable inside withinLimit.
The freshly deployed home token address is only used within the deploy-and-handle function.
The foreign token address resolution is local to message construction in passMessage.
The returned message id is captured and written to storage directly inside passMessage.
